Sometimes I wake up with a feeling like I had a strange and interesting dream, but I cannot remember a single thing about it no matter how hard I try.
How can I remember more about my dreams?

Keep a dream journal?

I don't know, I never remember my dreams. I'm tempted to record myself sleeping to see if that jogs any memories, but that'd be super weird.

Write everything you do remember down immediately after you wake up. I usually only have 5 minutes of clear memory when I wake up. That 5 minutes is followed by consciousness, it exaggerats and once it exaggerats the memory is clouded. Put an alarm on your phone for five minutes, and start writing. The longer you do that the longer your clear memory will last.

A dream journal is definitely the best way to increase dream retention. I suggest you title each dream (usually 3 or so a night) and be as detailed as possible. It also helps to remain motionless with your eyes closed when you first wake up. The fun part is when you go back through the journal after some time and look for themes within your subconscious.

The best way (you won't like it) is to pay a LOT of money for a good sleep tracker. Then program your alarm to wake you up after the first 45 minutes of each REM cycle (waking you during your dream). Waking up in the middle of a dream is the only way to remember it fully. Write down your dream, and repeat.

Or you can just learn to live with not remembering something that is of no importance anyways.

A final alternative is to start lucid dreaming. Google it, there are literally thousands of people who devote their lives to living out their fantasies in controllable, memorable dreams.
